# Homestill

[Homestill](https://homestill.app/) is a free, open-source (MIT), independent native Home Assistant app for Android (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, 4.2 MB) and iPhone (SwiftUI, no third-party libraries) that focuses on room-based device controls and live cameras while leaving out dashboards, history, automations and settings editing. It controls lights (with a hue and saturation color wheel and warmth bar), switches, fans, covers, locks, buttons, scenes, scripts, thermostats, water heaters, humidifiers, media players, robot vacuums, lawn mowers, valves, sirens, remotes, alarm panels (codes are never stored) and number/select settings, shows sensor, door/motion and weather readings as one-line tiles with no graphs, and plays live cameras over low-latency HLS (0.2 to 0.65 seconds to first frame in tests, falling back to a one-second still) with ONVIF pan-and-tilt arrow buttons in full-screen view. Everything runs over one WebSocket with instant cached state on launch, optimistic tile updates, in-app login with two-factor support storing only a refresh token, and no account, analytics or tracking; Homestill is not affiliated with Home Assistant.

Homestill 1.0.0 for Android is available on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.borodutch.homestill) and as a direct [signed Android APK](https://github.com/backmeupplz/homestill/releases/latest/download/homestill.apk); the iPhone app is coming to the App Store. Source code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/backmeupplz/homestill) under the MIT license.
